issues.on_page: SPECIAL ITEMS: Nonroutine maintenance (13,640); Casualty loss income 31,807; Casualty loss expense (48,024)
issues.issue: The special items are recorded as adjustments, which the rules allow. But 61,664 of maintenance and casualty-loss spending and 31,807 of casualty (insurance-type) income are left out of receipts and disbursements. Arithmetic checks out (net -29,857).
